'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Bosnian general election]]
**[[Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnians]] vote to elect the three members of the [[Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina|presidency]] and 42 members of the [[House of Representatives of Bosnia and Herzegovina|House of Representatives]]. Concurrent elections are also held in the [[Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Federation]] to [[2026 Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina general election|elect 98 seats]] of the [[House of Representatives of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina|regional legislature]] and in [[Republika Srpska]] to [[2026 Republika Srpska general election|elect]] the entity's [[President of Republika Srpska|president]] and the 83 seats of the [[National Assembly (Republika Srpska)|respective legislature]]. *[[2026 Brazilian general election]]
**[[Brazilians]] head to the polls to elect their [[President of Brazil|president]], [[Vice President of Brazil|vice president]], 513 members of [[Chamber of Deputies]] and 54 members in the [[Federal Senate (Brazil)|Federal Senate]]. Incumbent president [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] is running for the fourth non-consecutive term, where his main opponent is [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro]] [[Brazilian Senate|senator]] [[Flávio Bolsonaro]], the son of former president [[Jair Bolsonaro]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/04/brazil-presidential-election-lula-flavio-bolsonaro (''The Guardian'')]
**Flávio Bolsonaro wins the first round and will face Lula da Silva in a [[Two-round system|runoff]] on 25 October. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-elections-lula-flavio-bolsonaro-laydown-c194f8965632c8af9bcc4e7a3716cd7c (AP)]
